meta_data.base_class: Return the record for the most points scored by a player in a <league-based sport> - refers to any competitive sport organized into formal leagues, in which players can accumulate individual point-based statistics over their career.

tool_template.name: sports_data.<class>.most_points_career
tool_template.description: Returns the record for the most points scored by a <class> player in a specific league.

league.description: The specific <class> league for which to fetch the record.

season_range.description: The range of seasons (e.g., '2000-2010') to consider when fetching the most points record for a <class> player.

include_playoffs.description: A flag indicating whether to include playoff points in the total career points for the <class> player.

minimum_games_played.description: The minimum number of games a <class> player must have played in their career to qualify for the most points record.

data_source.description: Specify which data source to use for fetching historical stats for the <class> player (e.g., 'official league API', 'sports-reference').
